notes: Windows Recruitment Hub v1.1.59 — In every candidate's expanded Pipeline Ridealong section, added a personalised professional day-before message preview and two one-click buttons: Copy ridealong message and Open WhatsApp chat. Copy includes their first name, tomorrow 11:45 AM depot reception arrival, fully charged phone, power bank, suitable work shoes, high-visibility vest (provided if needed), and notice they'll be added to the driver WhatsApp group shortly. WhatsApp uses the same verified candidate-number chat-opening shortcut as the Contract follow-up: Windows desktop app first, wa.me browser fallback, with no auto-send or prefilled text. Invalid or missing numbers disable WhatsApp. The reminder explicitly says 'tomorrow', with a visible day-before-use hint. Neither button changes ridealong dates, stage checkboxes, timers, candidate history or official MBL records. Keeps the existing midnight black/red Pipeline design and all existing candidates' progress. Automatic PC/laptop cloud sync remains disabled under development. Tests cover formatting, required kit, chat links, no background writes and script load order.
